---
title: "xdalign"
---

## Description

Proper numbers alignment in PDF or RTF: period under period (decimal alignment)

## Parameters

**`invar`**

: Input variable name

  *Required:* Yes

**`type`**

: Type of the output, extension

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `RTF`

**`escapechar`**

: Escape character

  *Required:* No

**`len`**

: Length of the whole variable in the output, including indentation

  *Required:* Yes

## Examples

```sas
%xdalign(trt_1,type=PDF,len=6);
```
